content.text: No exclusivity obligation on Customer exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services"), and Contractor agrees to furnish the Services on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement.
input.rationale: The engagement is expressly task-by-task under separate Statements of Work, and no clause imposes any exclusivity, sole-supplier, requirements-purchase, or no-third-party-procurement obligation on Company. Searches for "exclusive", "sole provider/supplier", "requirements", "exclusively", "non-compete", "first refusal" and "right to match" returned only (i) Contractor's ownership of its own pre-existing materials and a non-exclusive licence to Company (p0020, p0021), (ii) the "complete and exclusive agreement" entire-agreement recital (p0051), and (iii) a mutual employee non-solicitation (p0047) — none of which restricts Company's freedom to source services elsewhere. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
